_comment: Flavour traits (R4.2, GAME_DESIGN.md 11). Every creature rolls one at creation; a second is rolled at the same time but withheld from display until bond crosses data/config/progression.json's traits.unlock_bond_nodes (creature_instance.gd::revealed_trait_secondary). Flavour/appraisal only -- nothing in GAME_DESIGN.md or MEADOWS_PROGRESSION_SPEC.md defines a numeric combat effect for a trait, so none is invented here; see scripts/creatures/trait_db.gd's own header.

bold.description: Charges into a fight without hesitating.

sturdy.description: Shrugs off knocks that would stagger others.

swift.description: Quick on its feet, first to react.

gentle.description: Easygoing around the trainer and the rest of the team.

stubborn.description: Digs in and does not back down.

curious.description: Investigates everything new before anything else.
